android.desc:
Typed is a clean, distraction-free markdown notes and note taking app for writers, students and anyone who wants their notes fast, organized and fully theirs.

Open the app and start writing. Format with markdown as you type, see a live preview, and keep everything sorted in folders and subfolders. Your notes stay on your device, and you can export them any time.

WRITE WITHOUT DISTRACTIONS
Typed is a minimal markdown editor with nothing in your way. Headings, lists, checkboxes, code blocks, quotes and links all work with standard markdown syntax, and live preview shows exactly how your note will look. Prefer plain text? Use it as a simple text editor or notepad and add formatting only when you need it.

ORGANIZE YOUR MARKDOWN NOTES
• Folders and subfolders for projects, classes or journals
• Tags to group related notes across folders
• Fast search and filters to find any note in seconds
• Pin and favorite the notes you use most

YOUR NOTES, YOUR FILES
• Export single notes or whole folders as Markdown (.md), plain text or ZIP
• Import markdown and text notes from other apps
• Notes are saved on your device, so you always know where they are
• No account needed, no data collected
• No ads

MADE FOR HOW YOU WRITE
• Light, dark and duo-tone themes, including a dark mode for writing at night
• Adjustable font size for comfortable reading and writing
• Works offline, so your notebook is always with you

USE TYPED AS…
• A note taking app for class notes, lecture summaries and study guides
• A writing app for blog drafts, articles, stories and ideas
• A private journal or diary you can export whenever you like
• An md editor for documentation, READMEs and code snippets
• A markdown editor for meeting notes, to-do lists and checklists

WHY MARKDOWN?
Markdown is plain text with simple formatting symbols, so your notes stay readable in any app, on any device, years from now. Typed makes markdown easy for beginners with live preview, and fast for people who already know the syntax.

Markdown notes, note taking and a distraction-free markdown editor in one offline app. Download Typed and start writing.

Questions or ideas? Email help@mazzestudios.com and we'll get back to you.
